arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one isolated full-body LILIPUTS.BMP game sprite. Both arms are lower and open: IMAGE RIGHT arm is longer and angles DOWN outward, image LEFT arm bends closer to torso and opens slightly upward. Hands EMPTY; no cord hanging from hands. A SMALL loose yellow rope curl sits ground LEFT beside ankles. Preserve the source lower release gesture, not high raised-hands shrug, and two distinct legs. No floor or shadows. Keep the frame-specific pose and head direction described above. Trace each arm from its shoulder through elbow to hand, and each leg from hip through knee to shoe, with natural joints and source occlusions. Do not duplicate a sleeve or add a third limb. Rope where present is flexible warm golden-yellow/tan cord with a thin dark contour, no glow; preserve its path and grip contacts. Keep all original props and entire figure safely inside the canvas with clear margins. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no scenery, floor plane, shadow, halo, text or extra props. Do not copy the reference key's generic upright standing pose.
